tools.name: world-spawn-tool-20261018.json
tools.description: Spawn a new VRChat world: first a public GitHub repo, then a cute one-line link in the Findastra profile README by pull request, then the Unity project skeleton. Preview by default. Before the next world, change its skeleton step to start from VCC's World template (Astra, 2026-10-18).
requirements: Python 3 and a signed-in GitHub CLI for --create-repo and --profile-pr.
Astra's OK for a new public repo; the profile change is a pull request she merges.
limitations: --apply still copies the skeleton from a reference world; Astra's rule since 2026-10-18 is to start fresh from VCC's World template, so change --apply before the next world.
Offline tests only; no Unity run is recorded.
